result.title: AgentTriage: Replayable Security Diagnosis Across Heterogeneous Agent Runtimes
result.summary: When tool-use agents write files, execute code, or send data, their final responses do not explain the resulting security events, and heterogeneous runtimes expose the relevant evidence through incompatible interfaces. We present AgentTriage, an executable contract for replayable security diagnosis across heterogeneous runtimes. The contract admits conclusions whose claims cite canonical runtime events and requires abstention when mandatory evidence is missing. Runtime overlays normalize native observations, while a deterministic pipeline joins invocation and result lifecycles, constructs a typed provenance graph, selects a policy-decisive slice, and binds claims to recorded evidence. Given the same normalized trace, overlay version, and pre-run policy oracle, the diagnosis can be recomputed and its claims re-checked without language-model judgment. Across five runtimes, one contract captures all 159 applicable executions, with an audit of native and synthesized identifiers. On 120 adjudicated cases, AgentTriage achieves 0.858 grounded joint diagnosis, 0.966 required-evidence coverage, and a 0.036 unsupported-claim rate, improving joint diagnosis by 0.175 (95% CI [0.092, 0.258]) over the strongest same-schema baseline. These results quantify the precision of replayable diagnosis and the observation boundaries that require abstention. We release an open-source implementation and selected sanitized evidence at https://github.com/AsnGs/agenttriage-open-source.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 AgentTriage，一个可重放的安全诊断契约：跨异构 agent 运行时规范化事件、连接调用与结果生命周期、构建类型化溯源图并选取策略决定性证据切片，把结论绑定到已记录证据，缺失必要证据时必须弃答。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「证据切片选择 + 结论—证据绑定 + 强制弃答」的确定性管道，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、STOP 决策与答案归因核验提供可核查的机制参照，但未涉及多模态 latent 状态，迁移需自行判断。
